key: Say, you think it's ethical to start fishing right after the environment recovers?
en: Say, you think it's ethical to start fishing right after the environment recovers?
ja: なあ、環境が回復したばかりで釣りを始めるのって、倫理的にどうなんだろうな?

key: Maybe the Pokémon would need more time to recover first...
en: Maybe the Pokémon would need more time to recover first...
ja: ポケモンたちにはもっと回復の時間が必要なんじゃないか……

key: ...Nah, fishing is a lifestyle! I'll go for it!
en: ...Nah, fishing is a lifestyle! I'll go for it!
ja: ……いや、釣りは生き様だ!やってやるぜ!

key: My skill in swimming is bar none! I'm on fire!
en: My skill in swimming is bar none! I'm on fire!
ja: 泳ぎの腕なら誰にも負けない!絶好調だぜ!

key: You burnt me out...
en: You burnt me out...
ja: おれ、もう燃え尽きた……

key: Maybe I should work on my battling skills, too...
en: Maybe I should work on my battling skills, too...
ja: バトルの腕も磨いといた方がいいかもな……

key: This is the kind of place I'm about.
en: This is the kind of place I'm about.
ja: ここはおれの性に合った場所だな。

key: All of the stench from the city before seems like a distant nightmare in the face of this fresh water scent.
en: All of the stench from the city before seems like a distant nightmare in the face of this fresh water scent.
ja: この澄んだ水の香りの前じゃ、前の街の悪臭なんて遠い悪夢みたいだ。

key: <>- Greycast Street\n^ -11th Street
en: <>- Greycast Street\n^ -11th Street
ja: <>- グレイキャスト通り\n^ -11番街

key: LILLIPUP: Ruffruffruffruffrrrrrr...!
en: LILLIPUP: Ruffruffruffruffrrrrrr...!
ja: ヨーテリー: ワンワンワンワンワウゥゥ……!

key: Lillipup ran away again!
en: Lillipup ran away again!
ja: ヨーテリーは また 逃げていった!

key: Coral Ward is totally the place to be, now that there's so many pretty things to look at!
en: Coral Ward is totally the place to be, now that there's so many pretty things to look at!
ja: コーラル区は今や見るものがたくさんあって、本当に最高の場所よ!

key: Oh, and I don't just mean the scenery~
en: Oh, and I don't just mean the scenery~
ja: あ、景色のことだけじゃないんだけどね～

key: All right boys, let's pull it together and haul out! We got a lot of work to catch up on!
en: All right boys, let's pull it together and haul out! We got a lot of work to catch up on!
ja: よし野郎ども、気合入れて出港するぞ!やることが山積みだ!

key: I wanna go out there and help too!
en: I wanna go out there and help too!
ja: あたしも出て行って手伝いたい!

key: I'm so tired of sitting around this city all day. Take me with you guys!
en: I'm so tired of sitting around this city all day. Take me with you guys!
ja: この街で一日中じっとしてるのはもう飽き飽きよ。あたしも連れて行って!

key: <>- Faeward Street\n^v -11th Street
en: <>- Faeward Street\n^v -11th Street
ja: <>- フェイワード通り\n^v -11番街

key: <>- Shantyport Street\nv -10th Street
en: <>- Shantyport Street\nv -10th Street
ja: <>- シャンティポート通り\nv -10番街

key: We've got our work cut out for us, now that it's safe to ship out again.
en: We've got our work cut out for us, now that it's safe to ship out again.
ja: また船を出せるようになったんだ、やるべきことは山ほどあるぞ。

key: The water may look clean, but there's still a lot of pollution in it, and sick Pokémon suffering.
en: The water may look clean, but there's still a lot of pollution in it, and sick Pokémon suffering.
ja: 水はきれいに見えるかもしれないが、まだ汚染は多く残ってて、病気で苦しんでるポケモンもいるんだ。

key: It's up to us to get out there and tie up the loose ends no machinery ever could!
en: It's up to us to get out there and tie up the loose ends no machinery ever could!
ja: 機械にはできない後始末をやり遂げるのは、おれたちの仕事だ!

key: You smell that, kid?
en: You smell that, kid?
ja: 坊主、この匂いがわかるか?

key: It smells like home.
en: It smells like home.
ja: 故郷の匂いだ。

key: You seen that lighthouse over there?
en: You seen that lighthouse over there?
ja: あそこの灯台、見えるか?

key: It was built way back when Reborn City was a small upstart town, and what's now Coral Ward was only a small pier on the lakeside.
en: It was built way back when Reborn City was a small upstart town, and what's now Coral Ward was only a small pier on the lakeside.
ja: リボーンシティがまだ新興の小さな町だった頃に建てられたもんでな、今のコーラル区は湖畔のちっぽけな桟橋にすぎなかったんだ。

key: However, it's been out of service ever since the city's first decline.
en: However, it's been out of service ever since the city's first decline.
ja: だが、街が最初に衰退して以来ずっと使われていない。

key: Door's locked up tight, too. Probably no one left alive has a key to it anymore.
en: Door's locked up tight, too. Probably no one left alive has a key to it anymore.
ja: 扉もがっちり施錠されててな。もう鍵を持ってる生きた人間なんて、誰も残っちゃいないだろうよ。

key: But who knows? Maybe there's another way to get in. Like a secret entrance, just barely out of sight somewhere!
en: But who knows? Maybe there's another way to get in. Like a secret entrance, just barely out of sight somewhere!
ja: だが誰にわかる?もしかしたら別の入り方があるかもな。どこかに隠された秘密の入口があるとかさ!

key: Heh, just kidding. But thinkin' that way keeps me entertained during the dull parts of fishing.
en: Heh, just kidding. But thinkin' that way keeps me entertained during the dull parts of fishing.
ja: へっ、冗談だよ。だがそんな風に考えてると、釣りの退屈な時間も紛れるんだ。

key: Say, do you think I'd have better luck over at Apophyll, or here?
en: Say, do you think I'd have better luck over at Apophyll, or here?
ja: なあ、アポフィルとここ、どっちの方が釣果がいいと思う?

key: Then again, since it's all the same lake, maybe it doesn't make a difference.
en: Then again, since it's all the same lake, maybe it doesn't make a difference.
ja: まあ、どうせ同じ湖なんだから、大した違いはないのかもな。

key: I can't wait to get back out there on the water's surface!
en: I can't wait to get back out there on the water's surface!
ja: また水面に出るのが待ちきれないぜ!

key: I've idled for so long. Gotta lose my land legs... and this gut!
en: I've idled for so long. Gotta lose my land legs... and this gut!
ja: ずいぶん長く陸に上がりっぱなしだった。陸の感覚を抜かないと……このお腹もな!

key: Heck with the lake's health. I wanna eat some fish!
en: Heck with the lake's health. I wanna eat some fish!
ja: 湖の健康なんて知ったこっちゃない。魚が食いてえんだよ!

key: You ever had a Seaking Steak?
en: You ever had a Seaking Steak?
ja: アズマオウステーキを食ったことあるか?

key: I made the right choice, choosing to move here when they were still rebuilding it!
en: I made the right choice, choosing to move here when they were still rebuilding it!
ja: まだ復興中の頃にここへ引っ越してきたのは正解だったな!

key: I was in Beryl all my life before that went haywire, but this is way more my speed!
en: I was in Beryl all my life before that went haywire, but this is way more my speed!
ja: あれがめちゃくちゃになる前はずっとベリルにいたんだけど、こっちの方がずっと性に合ってるよ!

key: On a night like this, there's something surreal.
en: On a night like this, there's something surreal.
ja: こんな夜は、何だか現実離れした感じがするんだ。

key: I can look at the sky, the lake, the stars, all fleeting as they are, but I feel like it could slip away at any second.
en: I can look at the sky, the lake, the stars, all fleeting as they are, but I feel like it could slip away at any second.
ja: 空も、湖も、星も、どれもはかくて――今にも消えてしまいそうな気がするんだ。

key: Like, maybe it already has once before.
en: Like, maybe it already has once before.
ja: なんていうか、前にも一度、消えたことがあるみたいに。

key: You ever get that feeling? Sort of like deja vu.
en: You ever get that feeling? Sort of like deja vu.
ja: そういう感覚になったことある?デジャブみたいな。

key: This has already happened once, and what you see now is the result of someone's imagination.
en: This has already happened once, and what you see now is the result of someone's imagination.
ja: これはもう一度起きたことで、今見えているものは誰かの想像の結果なんじゃないかって。

key: I'm not sure if I would like that or not.
en: I'm not sure if I would like that or not.
ja: それが好きなのかどうか、自分でもよくわからないんだ。

key: I moved here from Spinel Town when I heard the city was being rebuilt...
en: I moved here from Spinel Town when I heard the city was being rebuilt...
ja: この街が復興中だって聞いて、スピネルタウンから引っ越してきたんだ……

key: But I never imagined it could be this grandiose!
en: But I never imagined it could be this grandiose!
ja: でもここまで壮大になるなんて想像もしてなかったよ!

key: The most recent report suggests that the toxicity level of the water is still declining at an incredible rate.
en: The most recent report suggests that the toxicity level of the water is still declining at an incredible rate.
ja: 最新の報告では、水の毒性レベルは今も驚くべき速さで低下し続けているらしい。

key: The Water Treatment Center alone is powerful-- when operational, of course--
en: The Water Treatment Center alone is powerful-- when operational, of course--
ja: 浄水センター単体でも強力なんだ――もちろん稼働している時の話だが――

key: But there's no way it should have been able to make this much of a difference in so little time.
en: But there's no way it should have been able to make this much of a difference in so little time.
ja: だが、こんな短期間でこれほどの効果が出せるはずがない。

key: I have a new hypothesis.
en: I have a new hypothesis.
ja: 新しい仮説がある。

key: The Pokémon must have woken up, come back, or out of hiding-- whatever the case may be.
en: The Pokémon must have woken up, come back, or out of hiding-- whatever the case may be.
ja: ポケモンたちが目を覚ましたか、戻ってきたか、隠れ場所から出てきたか――理由が何であれ、そうに違いない。

key: I bet they're working hard to clean the lake too.
en: I bet they're working hard to clean the lake too.
ja: きっと彼らも湖をきれいにしようと頑張ってるんだろう。

key: We just had to give them a little shove.
en: We just had to give them a little shove.
ja: 私たちはただ、少し背中を押してやればよかったんだ。

key: Now, how to test this...
en: Now, how to test this...
ja: さて、これをどう確かめたものか……

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: カギが　かかっている

key: "Shantyport Station"
en: "Shantyport Station"
ja: 「シャンティポート駅」

key: \PN used the Coral Key.
en: \PN used the Coral Key.
ja: \PNはコーラルのカギを使った。

key: The door opened!
en: The door opened!
ja: 扉が開いた!

key: Hey there, kid. I don't suppose you're interested in gourmet dining, are you?
en: Hey there, kid. I don't suppose you're interested in gourmet dining, are you?
ja: よお坊主。グルメな食事に興味はないか?

key: I got some fresh Slowpoke Tail here.
en: I got some fresh Slowpoke Tail here.
ja: 新鮮なヤドンのしっぽがあるんだ。

key: Cut's as juicy as any.
en: Cut's as juicy as any.
ja: 肉汁たっぷりの上物だぜ。

key: And you better believe this stuff is rare down here.
en: And you better believe this stuff is rare down here.
ja: それにこの辺じゃかなり貴重な代物だってこと、忘れるなよ。

key: Slowpoke in Reborn are a prized and rare sight to see while fishing.
en: Slowpoke in Reborn are a prized and rare sight to see while fishing.
ja: リボーンのヤドンは、釣りをしていてもめったにお目にかかれない貴重な存在なんだ。

key: So you know it's a delicacy.
en: So you know it's a delicacy.
ja: だから、これがごちそうだってわかるだろ。

key: I'm sellin' for only $500,000. That's a steal!
en: I'm sellin' for only $500,000. That's a steal!
ja: たったの$500,000で売ってやるよ。破格だろ!

key: \GWhat do you say?
en: \GWhat do you say?
ja: \Gどうする?

key: Nice. You know how to cook 'em?
en: Nice. You know how to cook 'em?
ja: いいね。調理の仕方は知ってるか?

key: I can give you some recommendations if you like, on the house.
en: I can give you some recommendations if you like, on the house.
ja: よければおすすめを教えてやるよ、サービスでな。

key: Oh, you're delivering for the Spyce?
en: Oh, you're delivering for the Spyce?
ja: おっ、ザ・スパイスに配達してるのか?

key: Tch, you should've said so in the first place.
en: Tch, you should've said so in the first place.
ja: ちっ、それなら最初からそう言えよ。

key: I've got a standing deal with them, so they'll cover the cost.
en: I've got a standing deal with them, so they'll cover the cost.
ja: あそことは取り決めがあるから、代金はあっちが持つんだ。

key: Geez, you were really about to pay that much yourself?
en: Geez, you were really about to pay that much yourself?
ja: おいおい、本気で自腹で払うつもりだったのか?

key: That's some devotion...
en: That's some devotion...
ja: たいした心意気だな……

key: Anyway, here.
en: Anyway, here.
ja: とにかく、ほら。

key: Keep it cool so it doesn't spoil, got it?
en: Keep it cool so it doesn't spoil, got it?
ja: 傷まないよう冷やしとけよ、いいな?

key: Tch, your loss.
en: Tch, your loss.
ja: ちっ、お前の損だぜ。

key: Come back when you learn what taste is.
en: Come back when you learn what taste is.
ja: 味ってものがわかるようになったら出直してこい。

key: Oh, and uh...
en: Oh, and uh...
ja: あ、それとその……

key: I'd appreciate it if you kept quiet about this exchange.
en: I'd appreciate it if you kept quiet about this exchange.
ja: この取引のことは黙っといてもらえると助かる。

key: Not everyone's a fan of the business, you know?
en: Not everyone's a fan of the business, you know?
ja: この商売、みんなが好意的ってわけじゃないからな?

key: ADRIENN: Okay, document the design maintenance procedures and draft a schedule for employees to check it.
en: ADRIENN: Okay, document the design maintenance procedures and draft a schedule for employees to check it.
ja: アドリエンヌ: では、設計のメンテナンス手順を文書化して、従業員が確認するためのスケジュールを作成してください。

key: ADRIENN: Public safety regulations, right?
en: ADRIENN: Public safety regulations, right?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 公共安全に関する規則、でしたね?

key: Get it online, print fliers, and have one of the volunteers post the ordinances throughout the city.
en: Get it online, print fliers, and have one of the volunteers post the ordinances throughout the city.
ja: ネットに掲載して、チラシを印刷し、ボランティアの誰かに条例を街中に掲示してもらってください。

key: WOMAN: Um...
en: WOMAN: Um...
ja: 女性: あの……

key: ADRIENN: You are... Steinsman. Crystal Street Complex, 2C. Am I remembering right?
en: ADRIENN: You are... Steinsman. Crystal Street Complex, 2C. Am I remembering right?
ja: アドリエンヌ: あなたは……スタインズマンさん。クリスタル通りの集合住宅、2Cでしたね。合ってますか?

key: WOMAN: Y-yes. Uh, we're still having the issue with the electricity...
en: WOMAN: Y-yes. Uh, we're still having the issue with the electricity...
ja: 女性: は、はい。あの、まだ電気の問題が解決してなくて……

key: ADRIENN: What, really? Someone was supposed to go by for that on Tuesday.
en: ADRIENN: What, really? Someone was supposed to go by for that on Tuesday.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 本当ですか?火曜日に誰かが対応するはずだったのですが。

key: WOMAN: Um, nobody showed up...
en: WOMAN: Um, nobody showed up...
ja: 女性: あの、誰も来なくて……

key: ADRIENN: Gracious. Okay, I am so sorry for the inconvenience.
en: ADRIENN: Gracious. Okay, I am so sorry for the inconvenience.
ja: アドリエンヌ: まあ。ご迷惑をおかけして本当に申し訳ありません。

key: Thank you for telling me. I know it must have been a huge let-down to deal with that for so long.
en: Thank you for telling me. I know it must have been a huge let-down to deal with that for so long.
ja: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。長い間そんな状態に耐えるのは、さぞ大変だったでしょう。

key: ADRIENN: You finished with the place on Kingsbury?
en: ADRIENN: You finished with the place on Kingsbury?
ja: アドリエンヌ: キングズベリーの現場は片づきましたか?

key: VOLUNTEER: Yes, everything should be shipshape up there now!
en: VOLUNTEER: Yes, everything should be shipshape up there now!
ja: ボランティア: はい、あそこはもう万事ばっちりのはずです!

key: ADRIENN: You're an angel.
en: ADRIENN: You're an angel.
ja: アドリエンヌ: あなたは天使ですね。

key: Could you escort Mrs. Steinsman here to Mr. Finesilver at the Neo-Circuit Power Plant?
en: Could you escort Mrs. Steinsman here to Mr.  Finesilver at the Neo-Circuit Power Plant?
ja: スタインズマンさんをネオサーキット発電所のファインシルバーさんのところまでご案内していただけますか?

key: He's filling in for Julia at the moment and should be able to help her.
en: He's filling in for Julia at the moment and should be able to help her.
ja: 今はジュリアの代理をしているので、対応できるはずです。

key: ADRIENN: There's your signature. Did you need anything else?
en: ADRIENN: There's your signature. Did you need anything else?
ja: アドリエンヌ: はい、サインです。他に何か必要ですか?

key: MAN: That's all! I'll get this back to the office right away.
en: MAN: That's all! I'll get this back to the office right away.
ja: 男性: それだけです!すぐに事務所へ持ち帰ります。

key: ADRIENN: Thank you-- all of you-- for your hard work. Please come find me if you have any problems.
en: ADRIENN: Thank you-- all of you-- for your hard work. Please come find me if you have any problems.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ありがとうございます――皆さん、よく頑張ってくれています。何か問題があれば、いつでも訪ねてきてください。

key: ADRIENN: Deep breath... Everything is wonderful.
en: ADRIENN: Deep breath... Everything is wonderful.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 深呼吸……すべて順調です。

key: \PN. It is a pleasure to see you again.
en: \PN. It is a pleasure to see you again.
ja: \PN。また会えてうれしいです。

key: ADRIENN: My apologies for making you wait, \PN. I hope you've been well.
en: ADRIENN: My apologies for making you wait, \PN. I hope you've been well.
ja: アドリエンヌ: お待たせして申し訳ありません、\PN。元気にしていましたか。

key: I understand you've been gone for a while-- but look!
en: I understand you've been gone for a while-- but look!
ja: しばらく留守にしていたそうですね――でも、見てください!

key: This whole place--
en: This whole place--
ja: この場所全体が――

key: This is the city that I can be proud of.
en: This is the city that I can be proud of.
ja: これが、私が誇れる街です。

key: Even if it fell apart before, the pieces were always there.
en: Even if it fell apart before, the pieces were always there.
ja: たとえ以前は崩れていたとしても、そのかけらはずっとここにありました。

key: It just took someone to put them back together.
en: It just took someone to put them back together.
ja: あとは誰かがそれを組み立て直すだけでよかったのです。

key: With the help of the local Gym Leaders, students from Apophyll and Onyx, and more volunteers than I could have ever hoped for,
en: With the help of the local Gym Leaders, students from Apophyll and Onyx, and more volunteers than I could have ever hoped for,
ja: 地元のジムリーダーたち、アポフィルとオニキスの生徒たち、そして望みうる以上のボランティアたちの助けを借りて、

key: I think we've really made a miracle happen here.
en: I think we've really made a miracle happen here.
ja: 私たちは本当にここで奇跡を起こせたのだと思います。

key: It was daunting--
en: It was daunting--
ja: 気が遠くなるようなことでした――

key: No, in the beginning, I'd almost say nightmarish--
en: No, in the beginning, I'd almost say nightmarish--
ja: いいえ、最初のうちはほとんど悪夢のようだったと言ってもいいでしょう――

key: But one doesn't make this happen with announcements and inspirational speeches alone.
en: But one doesn't make this happen with announcements and inspirational speeches alone.
ja: ですが、これはお知らせや感動的な演説だけで成し遂げられることではありません。

key: I started one house at a time, taking a personal interest in each crack and story within its walls,
en: I started one house at a time, taking a personal interest in each crack and story within its walls,
ja: 私は一軒ずつ、その壁の中にあるひび割れ一つ一つ、物語一つ一つに個人的な関心を寄せながら始めました。

key: And from teaching others to do the same in return, everything has erupted outwards into some kind of dream.
en: And from teaching others to do the same in return, everything has erupted outwards into some kind of dream.
ja: そして他の人々にも同じことを教えることで、それがすべて外へと広がり、ある種の夢のようなものになったのです。

key: But we're not done yet.
en: But we're not done yet.
ja: だが、まだ終わりではない。

key: Not even close.
en: Not even close.
ja: まったく足りません。

key: That's enough though. You came to see me for a reason, I assume?
en: That's enough though. You came to see me for a reason, I assume?
ja: でも、もう十分ですね。何か理由があって会いに来たのでしょう?

key: Ame's calling for me?
en: Ame's calling for me?
ja: アメがわたしを呼んでいるのですか?

key: Understood. Please go on ahead.
en: Understood. Please go on ahead.
ja: わかりました。先に行っていてください。

key: I have a couple more things to finish, but I'll be right there.
en: I have a couple more things to finish, but I'll be right there.
ja: あと少し片づけなければならないことがありますが、すぐに向かいます。

key: What should I do next?
en: What should I do next?
ja: 次は何をすればいいですか?

key: About these new regulations...
en: About these new regulations...
ja: この新しい規則についてなんですが……

key: I need you to sign this, Mx. Adrienn.
en: I need you to sign this, Mx. Adrienn.
ja: アドリエンヌさん、これにサインをお願いします。

key: The waterway filter has been completed. How should we proceed?
en: The waterway filter has been completed. How should we proceed?
ja: 水路のフィルターが完成しました。次はどう進めましょうか?

key: Um, excuse me...
en: Um, excuse me...
ja: あの、すみません……
